command:
set -euo pipefail
export PLUMED_KERNEL=/opt/conda/lib/libplumedKernel.so
cd /tmp

echo "== GROMACS runs a rigid-water MD with PLUMED coupled live (-plumed) =="
# The chain: GROMACS integrates and hands coordinates to PLUMED every step; PLUMED computes
# collective variables and writes COLVAR. spc216 + amber99sb-ildn/tip3p ship in the gromacs
# package (zero staging). Water is held rigid (constraints), so the O-H distance and H-O-H
# angle are exact force-field constants -- a fixed-geometry check, not a sampled one -- and
# a CV that comes out right validates the GROMACS<->PLUMED coupling and PLUMED's CV machinery,
# not the two tools in isolation.
GRO=/opt/conda/share/gromacs/top/spc216.gro
printf '#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/forcefield.itp"\n#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/tip3p.itp"\n[ system ]\nwater\n[ molecules ]\nSOL 216\n' > topol.top
printf 'integrator = md\nnsteps = 50\ndt = 0.002\ncutoff-scheme = Verlet\ncoulombtype = cut-off\nrvdw = 0.9\nrcoulomb = 0.9\nconstraints = h-bonds\n' > md.mdp
# DISTANCE (O-H1) and ANGLE (H1-O-H2) of water 1; PLUMED atom indices are 1-based
printf 'd: DISTANCE ATOMS=1,2\na: ANGLE ATOMS=2,1,3\nPRINT ARG=d,a FILE=COLVAR STRIDE=10\n' > plumed.dat
gmx_mpi grompp -f md.mdp -c "$GRO" -p topol.top -o t.tpr -maxwarn 5 > grompp.log 2>&1
gmx_mpi mdrun -s t.tpr -deffnm out -plumed plumed.dat -nsteps 50 > mdrun.log 2>&1

python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys, numpy as np
rows=[l.split() for l in open("COLVAR") if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")]
t=np.array([float(r[0]) for r in rows]); d=np.array([float(r[1]) for r in rows]); a=np.array([float(r[2]) for r in rows])
mdrun=open("mdrun.log").read(); fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
# GROMACS+PLUMED coupling actually ran and PLUMED wrote the CV file
check("gromacs_plumed_ran", "Performance:" in mdrun and len(d)>0, f"{len(d)} COLVAR rows, mdrun {'finished' if 'Performance:' in mdrun else 'NO'}")
check("colvar_rows", len(d)==6, f"{len(d)}  want 6 (50 steps / stride 10 + t=0)")
# exact-geometry: PLUMED's DISTANCE == the TIP3P O-H constrained bond length (0.09572 nm)
check("distance_cv", abs(d.mean()-0.09572)<1e-4, f"{d.mean():.5f} nm  want 0.09572 (TIP3P O-H, PLUMED DISTANCE)")
# exact-geometry: PLUMED's ANGLE == the TIP3P H-O-H angle (104.52 deg = 1.82422 rad)
check("angle_cv", abs(a.mean()-1.82422)<2e-3, f"{a.mean():.5f} rad  want 1.82422 (104.52 deg, PLUMED ANGLE)")
# rigid water: both CVs are invariant across the trajectory (a construction, not sampling)
check("distance_invariant", (d.max()-d.min())<1e-4, f"spread {d.max()-d.min():.2e} nm  want < 1e-4 (rigid)")
check("angle_invariant", (a.max()-a.min())<1e-3, f"spread {a.max()-a.min():.2e} rad  want < 1e-3 (rigid)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
